headline: Kaczyński convenes special meeting on Zondacrypto. Warns PiS politicians
summary: Jarosław Kaczyński announced a special meeting within the PiS party over the Zondacrypto affair. He said the party would address the problem internally and urged others to do the same.
why: Zondacrypto is a cryptocurrency trading platform, and the affair links the crypto business to Polish politics, which can affect investor confidence in the sector.
